title: Tag chips that read like the status labels

steps.path: Type /resume, then look at the tags under a conversation's name
steps.headline: Tag names are now written in normal text, with the tag's color as a soft fill behind them.
steps.changed: Each tag's word is now the theme's text color. The tag's color moved into a light wash and the outline, like the Working label.
steps.notice: Tags are easier to read on the light themes, where colored words looked faint.
steps.risk: Similar tag colors, like blue and indigo, are a little harder to tell apart at a glance.

steps.path: Click the session name at the top, or hold Shift, and look at the tags under the Working label
steps.headline: The tags in the session switcher change the same way, so they now match the Working label right above them.
steps.changed: It is the same tag chip as the resume browser, so it changed here too, and in the tag picker and close-session prompt.
steps.notice: Tags now look like siblings of the status label beside them.
